questions.question: Noun of the word ‘poor’ is ----
questions.explanation: 'Poor' (গরিব) একটি Adjective। এর Abstract Noun form হলো 'Poverty' (দারিদ্র্য)।

questions.question: Verb of the word ‘new’ is ----
questions.explanation: 'New' (নতুন) একটি Adjective। এর Verb form হলো 'Renew' (নবায়ন করা)। Newness হলো noun।

questions.question: He is beating the thief –এর পরিবর্তিত voice form হচ্ছে ----
options: The thief was being beaten by him.
The thief is being beat by him.
The thief is beaten by him.
The thief is being beaten by him.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous Active 'He is beating the thief'-এর Passive রূপ হলো: 'The thief is being beaten by him.'
questions.correct_answer: The thief is being beaten by him.

questions.question: Who opened the door?- এর পরিবর্তিত voice হচ্ছে ----
options: By whom was the door be opened?
By whom was the door opened?
By whom is he door opened?
By whom has the door opened?
questions.explanation: Past Indefinite Interrogative Active 'Who opened the door?'-এর Passive রূপ: 'By whom was the door opened?'
questions.correct_answer: By whom was the door opened?

questions.question: My father said to me, “We are going there tomorrow.” বাক্যের Indirect speech হচ্ছে ---
options: My father told me that they would be going there the next day.
My father said to me that they are going there the next day.
My father told me that they were going there the next day.
My father told me that they are going there the next day.
questions.explanation: Direct speech-এর Present Continuous (are going) এবং tomorrow Indirect-এ যথাক্রমে Past Continuous (were going) এবং the next day-তে পরিবর্তিত হয়: 'My father told me that they were going there the next day.'
questions.correct_answer: My father told me that they were going there the next day.

questions.question: He said, “What a pity!” বাক্যের Indirect speech হচ্ছে ---
options: He said that it was a great pity.
He exclaimed that it is a great pity.
He exclaimed that it was a great pity.
He said that it is a great pity.
questions.explanation: Exclamatory বাক্যের Indirect রূপ: 'He exclaimed that it was a great pity.'
questions.correct_answer: He exclaimed that it was a great pity.

questions.question: “The disgruntled man grumbled ----his fate.” বাক্যের শূন্যস্থানে সঠিক শব্দ বসবে ---
questions.explanation: ভাগ্যের ওপর অসন্তোষ প্রকাশ করে বিড়বিড় বা অসন্তোষ প্রকাশ করা বোঝাতে 'grumble at' বসে: 'The disgruntled man grumbled at his fate.'

questions.question: “You are not amenable -----reason.” বাক্যের শূন্যস্থানে সঠিক শব্দ বসবে ---
questions.explanation: 'Amenable to' একটি appropriate preposition, যার অর্থ যুক্তিমেনে চলা বা বশ্যতা স্বীকার করা (responsive / willing to listen to reason)।

questions.question: ‘Bag and baggage’ idiom এর অর্থ হচ্ছে----
questions.explanation: 'Bag and baggage' idiom-টির অর্থ তল্পিতল্পাসহ বা সমস্ত জিনিসপত্র গুটিয়ে কোনো কিছু পেছনে না রেখে চলে যাওয়া (Leaving nothing behind / with all belongings)।

questions.question: ‘Loaves and fishes’ idiom টির অর্থ হচ্ছে----
questions.explanation: 'Loaves and fishes' একটি বাইবেলীয় বাগধারা, যার অর্থ বস্তুগত বা ব্যক্তিগত আর্থিক সুযোগ-সুবিধা (Material benefits / personal gains)।

questions.question: কোনটি শুদ্ধ বাক্য?
options: I suffered from fever for a week.
Let you and he be the witness.
questions.explanation: Comparative degree 'taller'-এর পর Subjective Pronoun 'I' বসে: 'Sohel is taller than I (am).' তাই ক সঠিক।

questions.question: কোনটি শুদ্ধ বাক্য?
options: Matin is good than his brother.
He was too clever to miss the point.
Your conduct admits at no excuses.
questions.explanation: Comparative degree 'taller'-এর পর Subjective Pronoun 'I' বসে: 'Sohel is taller than I (am).' তাই ক সঠিক।
questions.correct_answer: He was too clever to miss the point.

questions.question: ‘Abolish’ শব্দের Synonym হচ্ছে –
questions.explanation: 'Abolish' শব্দের অর্থ কোনো আইন বা প্রথা বাতিল বা বিলুপ্ত করা। এর যথার্থ সমার্থক হলো 'Cancel' (বাতিল করা) বা revoke/annul।
